mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( user_id, address_id, address, full_name, phone, city, pincode, total_amount,status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{addressId}, #{address}, #{fullName}, #{phone}, #{city}, #{pincode}, #{totalAmount}, 'PLACED' )
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, price, total_amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{quantity} * #{price})
mapper.select: SELECT id, address, total_amount AS totalAmount FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.status, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.created_at AS createdAt,
o.full_name AS fullName, o.phone, o.address, o.city, o.pincode
FROM orders o
WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.status, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.created_at AS createdAt,
o.full_name AS fullName, o.phone, o.address, o.city, o.pincode
FROM orders o
WHERE o.id = #{orderId}
SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, oi.quantity, oi.price FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT
o.id AS orderId, o.status, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.total_amount AS totalAmount,
u.name AS customerName, u.email AS customerEmail, a.phone, o.address
FROM orders o
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN addresses a ON o.address_id = a.id
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
